# WaterUps Image Creatives

## Creative 3 – “Your Garden, Smarter From The Roots”

**Creative Type:** Educational / Product Demonstration Static

**MAIN HEADLINE:**

YOUR GARDEN, SMARTER FROM THE ROOTS

**SUBHEADLINE:**

WaterUps wicking technology helps deliver water from the reservoir to your plants when they need it.

**VISUAL DIRECTION:**

Create a clean cross-section illustration of a WaterUps planter/wicking bed.

**Show clearly:**

- Water reservoir at the bottom
- Wicking cells / wicking system
- Growing medium
- Plant roots
- Water moving upwards towards the roots

**Add a visual arrow showing:**

WATER RESERVOIR  
↓  
WICKING SYSTEM  
↓  
PLANT ROOTS  
↓  
HEALTHIER GROWTH

**BENEFIT CALLOUTS:**

✓ Smarter water delivery  
✓ Less frequent watering  
✓ Healthier plant growth  
✓ Designed for sustainable gardening

**BOTTOM CTA:**

DISCOVER WATERUPS WICKING SYSTEMS
